# Vector Towards

Source: [4759](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4759); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Vector Towards](../../api/values/vector-towards.md).

<a id="wiki-4759-n1"></a>

- Vector Towards is displacement rather than normalized direction; unlike Direction Towards it retains distance.

Source limitations:

- Return type labeled Direction can encourage confusing displacement with unit direction.
